scope: Local CPU research. No original code modified; only this independent JSON written. No simulator startup/import, FK recomputation, network, GPU, installation, training, robot control or deletion. Python lacks numpy; NPZ inspected through standard-library zipfile/struct/ast/array.
primary_conclusions: Recovered collector source DOES use command-base increments, just like deployment sim/actions.py. It is not a measured-base expert versus command-base deployment split.

The same-column expert computes rate-limited displacement from FK(previous applied joint command) toward an absolute privileged waypoint. The common converter produces absolute IK joint targets; env rate-limits those targets relative to previous commands and applies finite-gain position servos for one control period.

Measured EEF, joint velocity and contacts still gate phase completion, speed and safety. Shared command-base control allows normal tracking error, but available NPZ cannot establish whether deployment i63 signed offset is typical expert tracking.

A distinct source-level semantic mismatch remains: training teaches realized measured EEF displacement, not the requested expert command increment. Applying that displacement from the commanded-pose base is not generally an inverse of collection. Shared controller design does not establish faithful replay.
The existing i63 base offset explains target geometry but alone proves neither a new deployment bug nor normal demonstration tracking, and does not establish failure causality.

semantic_equations.definitions: m_t=measured EEF before transition t; c_t=FK(last applied command before transition t)=FK(stored_action[t-1]); u_t=stored_action[t]; c_(t+1)=FK(u_t). Reset and terminal/cross-episode transitions need separate handling.
semantic_equations.expert: d_t=rate_limit(absolute_waypoint_t-c_t); target_t=c_t+d_t; u_t=joint_limit(IK(target_t)); dynamics evolve under u_t for 50 ms.
semantic_equations.deployment_no_saturation: target_replay_t=c_t+0.025*(2*a_t)=c_t+(m_(t+1)-m_t). Its pre-IK difference from m_(t+1) is c_t-m_t.
semantic_equations.tracking_error_relation: Let e_t=c_t-m_t. Then c_(t+1)-c_t=(m_(t+1)-m_t)+(e_(t+1)-e_t). Measured displacement equals post-IK/post-limiter command FK increment only if tracking error is locally constant. Dynamic equivalence additionally needs matched position/velocity/contact/controller state.
semantic_equations.caveats: IK residual, joint limiting and adapter saturation break simplistic endpoint equivalence. Translation saturation occurs when doubled adapter output exceeds [-1,1]. Do not automatically switch to measured-base execution; source explicitly avoids integrating idle-arm sag. No change proposed/applied.

verified_evidence.fact: _servo replaces measured arm q with last_applied_action; FK gives cmd_pos; pos_err=absolute waypoint-cmd_pos; bounded step divided by cartesian_translation_scale_m creates normalized delta. Speed argument is displacement per invocation, not m/s.
verified_evidence.verified_excerpt:
162:     def _servo(self, position, rotation, opening, speed=0.0024):
163:         """Rate-limited Cartesian delta TCP command."""
164:         work = self.env._ik._work
165:         work.qpos[:] = self.data.qpos
166:         work.qpos[list(self.env._ik._qpos_ids[0])] = self.env.last_applied_action[:7]
167:         work.qpos[list(self.env._ik._qpos_ids[1])] = self.env.last_applied_action[8:15]
168:         mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.model, work)
169:         cmd_pos = work.site_xpos[self._l_site].copy()
170: 
171:         target_pos = np.asarray(position, dtype=np.float64)
172:         pos_err = target_pos - cmd_pos
173:         dist = np.linalg.norm(pos_err)
174: 
175:         # Soft deceleration ramp to prevent abrupt stopping impact
176:         decel_dist = 0.020
177:         if dist < decel_dist and speed > 0.0020:
178:             effective_speed = max(0.0012, speed * (dist / decel_dist))
179:         else:
180:             effective_speed = speed
181:         step_dist = min(dist, effective_speed)
182:         if dist > 1e-6:
183:             delta_p = (pos_err / dist) * (step_dist / self.env.config.cartesian_translation_scale_m)
184:         else:
185:             delta_p = np.zeros(3)
186:         delta_p = np.clip(delta_p, -1.0, 1.0)

294:     def _limit_joint_action(self, canonical: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
295:         command = validate_action(canonical, "joint_position").copy()
296:         # Rate-limit the commanded trajectory, not the measured state. Limiting against
297:         # measured qpos caps the position error (and therefore actuator torque), which can
298:         # make gravity compensation impossible for the shoulder joints.
299:         current = self._last_applied_action
300:         arm_command = np.r_[command[:7], command[8:15]]
301:         arm_current = np.r_[current[:7], current[8:15]]
302:         arm_command = np.clip(arm_command, self._arm_ranges[:, 0], self._arm_ranges[:, 1])
303:         if self.action_mode == "cartesian_delta":
304:             arm_delta = arm_command - arm_current
305:             max_delta = float(np.max(np.abs(arm_delta)))
306:             if max_delta > self.config.max_joint_step_rad:
307:                 arm_delta = arm_delta * (self.config.max_joint_step_rad / max_delta)
308:             arm_command = np.clip(
309:                 arm_current + arm_delta,
310:                 self._arm_ranges[:, 0],
311:                 self._arm_ranges[:, 1],
312:             )
313:         else:
314:             arm_command = np.clip(
315:                 arm_command,
316:                 arm_current - self.config.max_joint_step_rad,
317:                 arm_current + self.config.max_joint_step_rad,
318:             )
